segment.source: Renders the opening claim beside a copyable command or short snippet — the install line, the curl call, the import — with documentation and repository actions under it. Use it for: open-source project pages, API and SDK landings, CLI tools, developer platform home pages, package readmes turned into a site. Prefer 'Documentation Hero' when the band opens the docs themselves, and 'Split Media Hero' when a screenshot would serve better than code.
